messages.content: I have the three Santa Fe hotel quotes now. Can we compare the real totals and the weekend logistics before I tell the office which room to reserve?

Yes. Send me each nightly rate, mandatory fee, parking charge, tax estimate, cancellation deadline, and check-in terms. I’ll compare all three for Friday through Monday and map them against Friday dinner, Saturday’s gathering, and Sunday near the plaza.

The plaza hotel is $252 a night, about 15% tax, and $28 nightly parking. No resort fee. It is a five-minute walk to Friday dinner, about an 18-minute drive to Saturday’s venue, and close to everything Sunday.

For three nights, that is $756 room, approximately $113.40 tax, and $84 parking, or about $953.40 total. Its main advantage is Sunday: museums, restaurants, and the plaza would all be walkable, and Friday dinner would not require moving the car.

El Sendero is $229 nightly. The office estimates $88 total tax, and parking is $10 a night. It’s about an eight-minute walk to Friday dinner, ten minutes by car to Saturday’s gathering, and an eight-minute drive to the plaza Sunday.

That comes to $687 room, $88 estimated tax, and $30 parking, for an estimated $805 total. It saves about $148.40 against the plaza hotel and is better positioned for Saturday, but on Sunday you would need to drive downtown and account for public parking.

The third one advertises $205, but it adds a $35 resort fee each night. Tax on the room and fee is about 15%. Parking is included. It is four minutes on foot from Friday dinner, sixteen minutes from Saturday, and roughly a six-to-ten-minute walk to the Sunday places.

Its three-night base is $615, resort fees add $105, and estimated tax is $108, producing an estimated total of $828. It is $23 more than El Sendero despite the lower advertised rate, though still about $125.40 below the plaza hotel. It offers strong Sunday convenience without a parking charge.

Now the terms. The plaza hotel allows cancellation until 4:00 p.m. two days before arrival and check-in is at 4:00, but it will accept the car and luggage earlier. El Sendero says cancellation by 6:00 p.m. two days before, check-in at 3:00, and early parking depends on space. The central property becomes nonrefundable seven days before arrival.

The plaza hotel has the clearest early-arrival arrangement. El Sendero’s 3:00 p.m. check-in still leaves ample time before the 6:30 dinner, assuming the Denver drive stays near schedule; its early-parking uncertainty matters only if you arrive well before check-in. The central property’s seven-day cutoff is materially less flexible and outweighs its modest Sunday advantage over El Sendero.
Put the actual weekend timing together. We are still leaving Denver at 7:00 Friday and do not want to be rushed before dinner.

A realistic plan is to allow roughly six hours of driving plus 45-60 minutes for fuel, lunch, and ordinary delays, targeting Santa Fe around 1:45-2:15 p.m. If El Sendero cannot take the car early, use the remaining time for a nearby stop and return for 3:00 check-in. Allow 30 minutes to park, settle in, and freshen up, then leave around 6:10 for the eight-minute walk to the 6:30 dinner. Saturday, leave about 1:25 p.m. for the 2:00 gathering, giving roughly 10 minutes to drive and 20-25 minutes to park and find the group. Sunday, drive to a public garage near the plaza around 9:30, spend the day walking among the museums and restaurants, and return to the inn after dinner. Monday’s 10:30 departure remains workable.

El Sendero still seems like the sensible choice. For the one room for the two of us, reserve a queen bed. A king is acceptable if that is the only larger-bed option, but don’t substitute two separate beds.

Agreed. Select El Sendero Inn for Friday, August 20 through Monday, August 23, one room for two adults, at an estimated lodging-and-parking total of $805. Request one queen bed; a king may be accepted if the queen is unavailable, but decline a two-bed substitution. Before charging anything, the office should reconfirm the $229 rate for all three nights, approximately $88 tax, absence of other mandatory fees, $10 nightly parking and space availability, the 6:00 p.m. cancellation deadline two days before arrival with the hotel’s exact local date, deposit and payment schedule, 3:00 p.m. check-in, checkout time, and the assigned room type. It should also verify both event addresses, the Friday walking route, Sunday garage options and rates, and whether luggage or the car can be accepted if you arrive before 3:00. Once those details match, the office can reserve it.
